tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker (test-first) implementing ONE bash script for the loop-stack board pipeline.
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-stack-session repo (branch i52-obsidian-board-mvp); edit files here directly. Do not push. Do NOT git commit at any point; leave every change uncommitted in the worktree (the harness exports your diff and the orchestrator applies and commits it).

You own ONLY this path; do not create, edit, or delete anything else:
- Create: scripts/board-render-obsidian.sh

The two committed templates assets/board/by-lane.base and assets/board/by-repo.base already exist at HEAD in this worktree (from Task 1). Read them; do not modify them.
The acceptance check tests/board/render.sh is FIXED and AUTHORITATIVE; the harness overwrites any copy with the canonical test and runs it. Do not edit it. It is reproduced verbatim at the end of this spec so you can develop test-first.

PORTABILITY (hard constraint): macOS stock /bin/bash 3.2. No associative arrays, no ${var,,}, no grep -P, no GNU-only flags. `set -uo pipefail`.

GOAL: scripts/board-render-obsidian.sh reads the Card TSV on stdin and writes the board directory: one note per card, two .base view files (copied from the committed templates only when absent), and a _health.md note. It is atomic and non-destructive.

CONSUMES: the Card TSV on stdin (12 fields, Task 3's contract); env LOOP_BOARD_HOME, LOOP_BOARD_CORTEX, LOOP_BOARD_CSS; the two committed templates assets/board/by-lane.base and assets/board/by-repo.base; the discovery skip counts on an optional third argument (a file path) for the health note.

PRODUCES: under LOOP_BOARD_HOME, one card note per Card TSV row, a _health.md note, and the two .base files (copied from the committed templates ONLY when absent). Writes NOTHING outside LOOP_BOARD_HOME except, when LOOP_BOARD_CSS=1, creating LOOP_BOARD_CORTEX/.obsidian/snippets/loop-board.css if and only if it is absent (write once, never refresh).

GUARD FIRST: fail with a `board:` message unless LOOP_BOARD_HOME is set, non-empty, and a path under LOOP_BOARD_CORTEX; never run a delete outside that directory.

REJECT MALFORMED INPUT: reject a row whose field count is not exactly 12 BEFORE any write, exit non-zero, leave the prior board intact.

ATOMIC RE-RENDER: write every new card note and _health.md into $LOOP_BOARD_HOME/.staging/, then move each into $LOOP_BOARD_HOME/, then prune orphaned old card notes (top-level files whose frontmatter has `board_card: true` and that are NOT in the new set), then remove .staging. A render that dies before the swap leaves the prior board intact; card notes are never deleted before their replacements exist. The two .base view files are preserved across renders (copied only when absent). Nothing else in the vault is touched.

CARD NOTE FILENAME: sanitized card_id (/ and # -> -) plus .md, e.g. create-loop-stack-session-I52.md.

CARD NOTE FRONTMATTER (the canonical key set, each mapping 1:1 from the Card TSV):
board_card: true
repo: <repo_key>
source: <tracker|git>
column: <one of the eight>
token: <I<n>|B<n>|empty>
staleness: <1..4>
last_work: <YYYY-MM-DD>
position: <local_position or empty>
behind: <behind_note or empty>
health: <ok|degraded|failed>
render_asof: <ISO-8601 timestamp>
title: <card title>

T1 SPIKE DISTILLATION (binding):
- Staleness display: prepend the band emoji to the note body H1 heading only: band 1 🟢, band 2 🟡, band 3 🟠, band 4 🔴. The frontmatter title: key and the filename stay verbatim per contract (no emoji there).
- Never rename the two seeded views; assets/board/loop-board.css scopes on data-view-name="By lane" and breaks if the view name changes.
- When LOOP_BOARD_CSS=1, the one-time snippet content is a byte copy of assets/board/loop-board.css (create-if-absent under LOOP_BOARD_CORTEX/.obsidian/snippets/, never refresh).

CARD NOTE BODY: two visual weights - recorded facts (bold label; last_work, tracker column) and derived facts (plain; staleness, local_position, behind), each carrying the render_asof as-of stamp - then the resume prompt in a fenced block composed from the row:
```
Resume: <repo_key>  <token or title>
State: <column> | <local_position or clean> | last work <last_work_date> (band <staleness_band>)
<behind_note, only when non-empty>
Entry: <entry point>
Next: cd <repo_path> && git log --oneline -5 && git status ; read config/context-map.md
```
ENTRY-POINT MAPPING (best-effort, first match wins):
- column == done -> "archive or close"
- column == blocked-on-you -> "answer the needs-input, then /loop-drive"
- source == git and local_position != clean -> "review and commit, then /loop-drive"
- a plan file exists for the repo (ls <repo_path>/docs/plans/*.md matches at least one) -> "/loop-drive"
- otherwise -> "/loop-plan"

_health.md lists, per source and per scope: tracker ok/failed per conforming repo, git ok/degraded counts, the non-git skip counts from discovery (the optional third-arg file), and the render timestamp. When LOOP_BOARD_CSS=1, it also prints the one-time instruction to enable the snippet under Settings > Appearance > CSS snippets.

Copy the .base templates from assets/board/ relative to the SCRIPT's own repo root (resolve the script directory, not the cwd).

HOW TO RUN (from worktree root): `bash tests/board/render.sh` must exit 0.
OUTPUT CONTRACT: scripts/board-render-obsidian.sh only; leave it uncommitted for patch export.
If anything is ambiguous, take the most conservative reading consistent with the acceptance test and note it at the end of your final message.

--- VERBATIM ACCEPTANCE TEST (tests/board/render.sh) ---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Render writes one note per card with correct frontmatter, seeds .base files only when absent,
# preserves user edits to an existing .base, writes a health note, survives a failed re-render
# without wiping the prior board (atomicity), and touches nothing outside the board home.
set -uo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
REPO="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"
fail() { echo "FAIL: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cortex="$tmp/Cortex"; home="$cortex/00_System/Board"; mkdir -p "$home"
outside="$cortex/20_Knowledge/keep.md"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$outside")"; echo "do not touch" > "$outside"
outside_hash() { find "$cortex" -type f -not -path "$home/*" -exec shasum {} + | sort | shasum; }
run() { LOOP_BOARD_HOME="$home" LOOP_BOARD_CORTEX="$cortex" bash "$REPO/scripts/board-render-obsidian.sh"; }

now="$(date +%s)"
card() { printf '%s\tcreate/%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t1\t2026-09-01\t%s\t%s\tok\t%s\n' \
  "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" "$6" "$7" "$8" "$now"; }
{
  card 'create/repoA#I52' repoA tracker in-session 'Board MVP' I52 '' ''
  card 'create/repoA#git' repoA git next-up 'repoA working tree' '' '2 uncommitted, +0 ahead' ''
} > "$tmp/cards.tsv"

before="$(outside_hash)"
run < "$tmp/cards.tsv" || fail "render exited non-zero"
n="$(grep -rl 'board_card: true' "$home" | grep -c .)"
[ "$n" -eq 2 ] || fail "expected 2 card notes, got $n"
grep -rq 'column: in-session' "$home" || fail "frontmatter column missing"
grep -rq 'Resume:' "$home" || fail "resume prompt block missing"
[ -f "$home/_health.md" ] || fail "health note missing"
[ -f "$home/by-lane.base" ] || fail "by-lane.base not seeded"

# user edits an existing .base; re-render must preserve it and must not touch outside files
echo "# user tweak" >> "$home/by-lane.base"
run < "$tmp/cards.tsv" || fail "re-render exited non-zero"
grep -q '# user tweak' "$home/by-lane.base" || fail "re-render clobbered the user .base edit"
[ "$(outside_hash)" = "$before" ] || fail "re-render altered a file outside the board home"

# atomicity: a render fed a malformed (wrong field count) row must exit non-zero and leave the
# prior board intact, never a wiped or half-built board.
printf 'bad\trow\tonly\tthree\n' > "$tmp/bad.tsv"
run < "$tmp/bad.tsv" && fail "render should reject a malformed row"
[ "$(grep -rl 'board_card: true' "$home" | grep -c .)" -eq 2 ] || fail "failed render wiped the prior board"
echo "PASS: notes, frontmatter, resume block, health note, .base preserved, atomic, outside untouched"
